items.text: Submit a retroactive authorization request (RETRO_AUTH_REQUEST) and the discharge summary (DISCHARGE_SUMMARY) as required for appeals of inpatient surgery under Section 4.1.
Gather and upload the missing documents to the claim portal within the 180‑day appeal window.
Past case HC-035 (V2024) was overturned after providing ITEMIZED_BILL and DISCHARGE_SUMMARY; similarly HC-036 (V2025) required DISCHARGE_SUMMARY to overturn a denial for missing records.
Future inpatient surgeries require prior authorization; failure to obtain may result in denial per Section 4.1.
